info.name: Core accepted countries Program Gateways API

params.name: count
params.description: Number of Program Gateway resources to retrieve.

params.name: start_index
params.description: Sort order index of the first resource in the returned array.

params.name: sort_by
params.description:
Field on which to sort.
Prefix the field name with a hyphen (`-`) to sort in descending order.
Omit the hyphen to sort in ascending order.

*NOTE:*
You must sort using system field names such as `lastModifiedTime`, and not by the field names appearing in response bodies such as `last_modified_time`.

items.docs:
Retrieve an array of existing Credit Program Gateways.

This endpoint supports <</core-api/sorting-and-pagination, sorting and pagination>>.

Create a new Credit Program Gateway.

Use this endpoint to configure your Program Gateway to receive gateway requests from Marqeta's credit platform.
You can create multiple Program Gateways, but only one can be active per credit program.

[NOTE]
To create a Program Gateway, you must have consumer or admin credentials.

params.name: token
params.description:
Unique identifier of the Program Gateway to retrieve.

Send a `GET` request to `/credit/programgateways` to retrieve existing Program Gateway tokens.
